notes:
Improved
• Risers: they build into big news, a reveal or a win, and into lines like "I'll reveal this now…". The riser peaks on the moment and stops; it never rings over the next line.
• Whooshes: when the story jumps ahead (a minute or more cut out) and when a transition title slides in.
• Awkward sounds (crickets, record scratch, the anime awkward sound) on an awkward or cringe beat.
• Pings: a Discord, chat, text or call mention gets a notification sound.
• Milestones: a pop-up of a number ("2 million subscribers") gets a ka-ching or shimmer instead of a plain pop.
• Fails get the wrong-answer buzzer, not a happy ding.
• Big news in a sad video gets a heavy, dramatic hit instead of a goofy one.
• Sounds tied to something on screen always play (pop-ups, transitions, numbers, pings). The judgment calls (jokes, shocks, reveals, risers) keep to your style's pace.
• Solis AI takes a second look at every joke, shock and reveal it picks, with the lines around it, and keeps only a clear yes. A one-word reply ("Okay.") never gets a sound.
• Music fits what the video is about, so a goodbye isn't scored hype.
• Pop-ups for channels, clans, games and numbers, and every pop-up gets its pop.
